prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production 2D animation sprite atlas for the existing semi-realistic Chinese rescue tactics game. Reference 1 supplies the top-row identities Lin (teal rain poncho female medic with cream bag), Xu (charcoal/navy male rescuer orange rope harness), Su (female burgundy vest cream shirt headset); ignore its objects. Reference 2 is Chen (middle-aged man glasses weathered brown work coat teal cuffs tool belt). Create ONE true transparent RGBA sprite sheet, exactly 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 1536x1024 landscape. Each equal cell 256x256 contains exactly ONE full-body cutout at consistent small game scale, boots aligned to 90% cell height, entire silhouette within central 80% cell width and 85% height. Row 1 Lin, row2 Xu, row3 Su, row4 Chen. In EACH row six distinct animation poses left to right: (1) walk left foot forward/right arm forward, (2) passing stance legs together and knee bent, (3) walk right foot forward/left arm forward, (4) passing opposite knee bent, (5) preparatory half-crouch bending knees reaching hands toward nearby machinery, (6) extended forceful tool-push/strike arms forward with weight on front foot. Same consistent three-quarter overhead camera facing lower-right, adult realistic anatomy, matching outfit/face and scale across every row, painterly realistic game rendering consistent with reference. Walking poses must visibly alternate bent legs and swinging arms, not repeated standing images. No scene, background, ground, shadows, labels, grid lines, text, extra people, panels, or merged/cropped figures. Leave transparent gutters. Every character head and boots fully within its own cell. Preserve alpha.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D animation atlas for a semi-realistic rescue tactics game. Reference is ONLY the four upper-row people; ignore all lower-row machines and background. Output ONE true transparent RGBA sheet exactly 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 1536x1024. Each 256x256 cell contains exactly one full-body person at the SAME scale and camera, boots aligned at 90% cell height, silhouette inside central80% width and85% height with transparent gutters. Row1 Ye: young Chinese woman orange rescue coat dark trousers boots. Row2 He: older broad Chinese man navy rescue suit yellow harness. Row3 Mo: Chinese woman olive field coat carrying tablet secured at hip while acting. Row4 Jiang: Chinese man teal short-sleeve shirt orange rescue vest dark trousers. Preserve each person's identity and outfit. Every row repeats this SIX-POSE sequence: 1 walking left leg extended forward, right arm forward; 2 left leg passing under body and other knee lifted; 3 walking right leg extended forward, left arm forward (clearly OPPOSITE legs from col1); 4 right leg passing under body with opposite knee lifted; 5 half-crouched preparation reaching down toward an object, bent knees; 6 push/strike follow-through with arms strongly extended, torso leaning and front leg braced. These must be distinct physical poses, not standing copies. Consistent three-quarter overhead view facing bottom-right, realistic adult proportions, detailed painterly semi-realistic rendering for 2D gameplay, matching source faces/colors. No cartoon, pixel art, background, floor, ground shadow, grid, labels, text, extra objects or merged figures. Actual transparent background. Entire head/hands/boots stay within each equal cell.
